description: Implementation of the RefRadioNetwork class handling radio network settings and emergency procedures in Android's radio HAL.

classes.name: RefRadioNetwork
classes.description: Class implementing radio network configuration and emergency procedures.

methods.name: setUsageSetting
methods.description: Sets the usage setting for the radio network, validating input and responding accordingly.

methods.name: setEmergencyMode
methods.description: Configures emergency mode with predefined network registration state.

methods.name: cancelEmergencyNetworkScan
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing emergency network scan.

methods.name: isN1ModeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if N1 mode is enabled.

methods.name: setNullCipherAndIntegrityEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables null cipher and integrity.

methods.name: isNullCipherAndIntegrityEnabled
methods.description: Checks if null cipher and integrity are enabled.

methods.name: setCellularIdentifierTransparencyEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables cellular identifier transparency.

methods.name: isCellularIdentifierTransparencyEnabled
methods.description: Checks if cellular identifier transparency is enabled.

methods.name: setSecurityAlgorithmsUpdatedEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables security algorithms update transparency.

methods.name: isSecurityAlgorithmsUpdatedEnabled
methods.description: Checks if security algorithms update transparency is enabled.
